selfContained.description: Whether the SVG contains no external url() or scripts

responsive.description: Whether viewBox is defined with width/height 100%

stackingOrderValid.description: Whether foreground and labels sit at the end of the DOM

transformIsolated.description: Whether animated elements separate coordinate translate from keyframe motion

boundaryClamped.description: Whether moving elements stay within canvas bounds

dualThemeVerified.description: Whether dark mode media query and CSS custom properties are properly defined

accessible.description: Whether the SVG includes role="img" and title/aria-labelledby accessibility attributes

reducedMotion.description: Whether animated SVG provides @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rules
